newsitem.title: JAPAN: Idemitsu Tokuyama topper to restart on November 18.
newsitem.headline: Idemitsu Tokuyama topper to restart on November 18.

text.p: Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd said on Monday that the 120,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) at its Tokuyama refinery in Yamaguchi prefecture, southern Japan, will restart on November 18.
The CDU was closed on September 24 for routine maintenence checks, a company spokesman said.

Idemitsu Kosan owns four refineries apart from Tokuyama. Scheduled turnarounds at its Hokkaido and Aichi refineries, which have capacity of 130,000 bpd and 160,000 bpd respectively, were completed earlier this year. It's Chiba and Hyogo refineries have no maintenance checks scheduled this year.
